svg.aria-label: Mean likelihood and unpenalised intercept derivation, stable original-logit evaluation and numerical derivatives with the same reduction and penalty must agree.
svg.title: Consistency of objective stable evaluation and checking
svg.desc: Mean likelihood and unpenalised intercept derivation, stable original-logit evaluation and numerical derivatives with the same reduction and penalty must agree.

g.text: Three implementations must express one objective
Derivation: mean NLL + λ‖w‖²/2; no b penalty
Evaluation: stable logit loss without changing the model
Check: smooth differences with the same reduction and penalty
Missing division by n is a formula fault, not fixed by smaller h.
